summary: ESU 13 urges the FCC to preserve E-Rate support for rural schools, emphasizing the ongoing need for connectivity and the financial impact on districts. ESU 13 urges the Commission to protect and modernize E-Rate to ensure students can access reliable, affordable connectivity regardless of location. ESU 13 opposes proposals to sunset or eliminate E-Rate and supports preserving support for Category One connectivity, Category Two internal connections, and Wi-Fi, among other services. ESU 13 emphasizes the importance of local school boards, educators, and families in making decisions about educational use, screen time, and appropriate content. ESU
